name: social-flow
description: The social-flow MCP tools for the Claude Desktop chat — research search, image, video, voice and music generation, and SNS publishing. A desktop extension carries no skills; the full pipeline installs as a plugin in Cowork.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: gpt_image_* — covers and any frame with text on it. Empty keeps the on-device image engine.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: veo_* video, tts_generate narration, music_* BGM. Empty keeps the on-device voice.

ark_api_key.title: BytePlus ModelArk API key
ark_api_key.description: seedance_* video. Optional — veo_* works without it.

sns_token_dir.title: Credentials directory
sns_token_dir.description: SNS token files, plus a .env file with every other variable (README § Environment variables). The server fills any key left empty here from that file.
